They must be ordered in sets of 50.
They include names at no extra cost.
qs.exp: 網頁上刷毛外套（fleece jacket）只有 black、charcoal 兩種顏色。外套 $48，比 Oxford 襯衫的 $34 貴；最低訂購量是每款 12 件，50 件是免運門檻；免費的是公司標誌，繡名字每件要加 $4。

qs.q: Why was Dunmore Veterinary Clinic charged for shipping?
opts: Its order had fewer than 50 items.
It asked for delivery by a set date.
It ordered jackets in a special color.
qs.exp: 雙篇整合：(1) 網頁說 50 件以上免運，否則收固定運費 $18；(2) 訂單是 24 件 polo 衫＋12 件外套＝36 件，未達 50 件，所以收了 $18。訂單上沒有指定送達日（開放日是之後客訴時才提的）；charcoal 是網頁上的標準顏色；訂單上也沒有要求加快生產（只要 5 個工作天的是追加訂單 reorder，這筆訂單也沒有走追加流程）。

qs.q: By how much was the clinic overcharged for name personalization?
qs.exp: 三篇整合，一步步算：(1) 網頁：繡名字每件 $4；(2) 訂單備註：名字只繡在 polo 衫上，但「Name personalization」收了 36 件 × $4＝$144；(3) 客訴信確認外套沒繡名字（這點是對的），卻每件都被收費。應收只有 24 件 polo × $4＝$96，所以多收了 12 件外套 × $4＝$48。$96 是應付的金額；$144 是實際收取的總額；$4 只是單件費用。

qs.q: What is suggested about Dunmore Veterinary Clinic?
opts: It has done business with StitchWorks before.
It is opening a second clinic in September.
It ordered jackets with staff names on them.
It received its order later than estimated.
qs.exp: 信中說「不像兩年前我們第一次跟你們訂的那批完全沒問題」，可推知以前就和 StitchWorks 合作過。9 月 5 日是辦開放參觀日（open house），不是開設新分院；訂單備註寫名字只繡在 polo 衫；預計 8 月 19 日出貨，上週五（8 月 21 日）就收到，沒有晚於預計。

qs.q: In the e-mail, the word "address" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
qs.exp: Please address both issues＝請處理這兩個問題 → deal with。address 也可以指「對（聽眾）演說」（speak to）或「把信寄給某人」（send to），但受詞是 issues（問題），只能是「處理」；write down 是「寫下來」。

p7.title: 三篇：商展參展公告＋報名表＋回覆信
passages:
MIDLAND FOOD & BEVERAGE TRADE FAIR
Thursday, November 12 - Saturday, November 14
Midland Exhibition Center, Hall C

CALL FOR EXHIBITORS
Last year, more than 9,000 buyers, restaurant owners, and food lovers visited the fair. Booth space is limited, so exhibitors are encouraged to secure a spot early. Booths are assigned in the order that registration forms are received.

BOOTH OPTIONS
  Standard booth (3 m x 3 m) ..................... $850
  Corner booth (3 m x 3 m, two open sides) ....... $1,050
  Premium booth (near main entrance,
    electrical connection included) .............. $1,400

- Electrical connection for Standard and Corner booths: $75
- Each booth includes two exhibitor badges. Additional badges: $40 each.
- Register by September 30 to receive a 15 percent discount on booth fees.
- Exhibitors who plan to offer food samples must obtain a temporary food permit from the City of Midland. Permit applications must be submitted by October 23.

To register, complete the exhibitor form on our Web site.

MIDLAND FOOD & BEVERAGE TRADE FAIR - EXHIBITOR REGISTRATION

Company: Calloway Spice Company
Contact: Diego Ferreira
E-mail: dferreira@callowayspice.com
Booth type: Corner
Electrical connection: Yes
Number of exhibitor badges needed: 4
Will you offer food samples? Yes
Products to be displayed: Spice blends, hot sauces, marinades
Date submitted: October 2

To: Diego Ferreira <dferreira@callowayspice.com>
From: Yuki Hamada, Exhibitor Coordinator
Date: Tuesday, October 6
Subject: Your booth registration

Dear Mr. Ferreira,

Thank you for registering for this year's fair. I'm sorry to say that all of our corner booths had been taken by the time your form arrived. I have assigned you Standard booth B-14, which is on the main aisle, just two booths from the cooking demonstration stage. To make up for the inconvenience, we will provide your electrical connection free of charge. Your other requests have been processed as submitted, and an updated invoice will be sent to you separately.

Also, since your company will be handing out samples, please be aware that the city's application deadline for the required permit is just over two weeks away.

We look forward to seeing you in November.

Best regards,
Yuki Hamada

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned in the announcement?
opts: The number of visitors last year
qs.exp: 公告提到去年超過 9,000 人參觀、攤位依報名表收到的先後順序分配、Premium 攤位在主入口附近；唯一沒提到的是一般參觀者的入場費。

qs.q: Why will Calloway Spice Company most likely pay the full booth fee?
opts: Its form was submitted after the deadline.
It was moved from a Corner to a Standard booth.
It requested more than two exhibitor badges.
Its electrical connection will be provided free.
qs.exp: 雙篇整合：(1) 公告說 9 月 30 日前報名，攤位費打 85 折（15 percent discount）；(2) 報名表的提交日期是 10 月 2 日，已經超過期限，所以拿不到折扣。改成標準攤位是因為角落攤位額滿，和折扣無關；多要的識別證只需每張另付 $40；電源免費是補償，不是取消折扣的理由。

qs.q: How much will Calloway Spice Company most likely be charged in total?
qs.exp: 三篇整合，一步步算：(1) 角落攤位額滿，回覆信改配標準攤位 B-14，公告上標準攤位 $850；(2) 10 月 2 日才報名，沒有早鳥折扣；(3) 回覆信說電源免費，原本的 $75 不收；(4) 表單要 4 張識別證，每個攤位含 2 張，多 2 張 × $40＝$80（回覆信說其他需求照原表單處理）。合計 $850＋$80＝$930。$1,005 是沒扣掉電源費（$850＋$75＋$80）；$1,130 是照原本申請的角落攤位計算（$1,050＋$80）；$802.50 是誤用了已過期的 85 折（$722.50＋$80）。

qs.q: What does Ms. Hamada say about booth B-14?
opts: It is close to a demonstration area.
It is located near the main entrance.
It comes with four exhibitor badges.
qs.exp: 回覆信說 B-14 在主走道上，離烹飪示範舞台只隔兩個攤位＝靠近示範區。兩面開放是角落攤位的特色；靠近主入口的是 Premium 攤位（B-14 是在主走道，不是主入口）；每個攤位只含兩張識別證，另外兩張要付費。

qs.q: What can be inferred about the corner booths?
opts: They had all been reserved by early October.
They are the most expensive type of booth.
They include a free electrical connection.
They are next to the cooking demonstration stage.
qs.exp: 回覆信說 Ferreira 的表單（10 月 2 日提交）送達時，角落攤位已經全部被訂走，可推知 10 月初就額滿了。最貴的是 $1,400 的 Premium 攤位；只有 Premium 攤位含電源，角落攤位電源要另付 $75；靠近烹飪示範舞台的是 B-14 這個標準攤位。

l2.q: Who's covering the front desk during lunch today?
opts: Hiro said he'd take the first hour.
The desk lamp needs a new bulb.
At the Italian place across the street.
l2.exp: Who 問今天午餐時間誰顧櫃檯，答「Hiro 說他會顧第一個小時」。「The desk lamp…」用 desk 做同字陷阱；「At the Italian place…」由 lunch 聯想到去哪裡吃飯，答的是地點，不是人。

l2.q: Who designed the new company logo?
opts: Yes, it looks much more modern.
I'm taking a design course this fall.
l2.exp: Who 問誰設計了新標誌，用反問「不是外面的廣告公司做的嗎？」間接回答，這是高分常見的正解型態。「Yes, it looks…」疑問詞問句不能用 Yes 回答；「design course」用 design 做同字陷阱。

l2.q: Who's giving the keynote speech at the retail summit?
opts: That's a key point in the report.
l2.exp: Who 問誰在零售高峰會做主題演講（keynote speech），間接回答「講者名單還沒定案」。「key point」和 keynote 發音相近，是音近陷阱；「About forty minutes」答的是多久，不是誰。

l2.q: What did you think of the new intern's presentation?
opts: She explained the data very clearly.
I think it starts at two.
l2.exp: What did you think 問對實習生簡報的看法，答「她把數據講解得很清楚」。「I think it starts at two」重複 think，而且答的是時間；「The internship lasts…」由 intern 聯想，沒有評價簡報。

l2.q: What's the fastest way to get to the convention center?
opts: The subway, at this time of day.
The convention opens on Friday morning.
Yes, I got there early this time.
l2.exp: What's the fastest way 問最快的去法，答「這個時段搭地鐵最快」。「The convention opens on Friday」答的是何時；「Yes, I got there early」疑問詞問句不能用 Yes 回答，get there 也只是同字重複。

l2.q: What's the dress code for the client dinner?
opts: The code is printed on your badge.
At seven, at the Harbor Grill.
l2.exp: What 問客戶晚宴的服裝規定（dress code），間接回答「我查一下邀請函」。「The code is printed…」的 code 是「代碼」，同字不同義；「At seven, at the Harbor Grill」答的是時間和地點。

l2.q: What's causing the delay on the production line?
opts: Please wait in line right here, sir.
l2.exp: What's causing 問生產線延誤的原因，答「有一台機器過熱」。「wait in line」的 line 是「隊伍」，同字不同義；「Production rose last year」重複 production，但沒說延誤原因。

l2.q: When is the deadline for the grant application?
opts: The end of this month, I think.
Please apply the stickers to each box.
l2.exp: When 問補助金（grant）申請截止日，答「我想是這個月底」。「apply the stickers」的 apply 是「貼上」，和 application 同字根但意思不同；「It's a fairly long form」只是由申請表聯想，沒說時間。

l2.q: When are you taking your vacation this year?
opts: That depends on the project schedule.
Yes, I took the whole week off.
l2.exp: When 問今年何時休假，間接回答「要看專案進度而定」。「To Portugal…」答的是去哪裡；「Yes, I took…」疑問詞問句不能用 Yes 回答，而且用過去式，和問未來的休假對不上。

l2.q: When should we send out the customer newsletter?
opts: To everyone on our customer mailing list.
l2.exp: When 問電子報何時寄出，答「產品發表之後馬上寄」。「Yes, the news…」用 Yes 回答疑問詞問句，news 和 newsletter 是拆字陷阱；「To everyone on our customer mailing list」答的是寄給誰，不是何時。

l2.q: Where did you get that standing desk?
opts: I prefer to stand during calls.
It adjusts to almost any height.
l2.exp: Where 問那張站立式書桌在哪裡買的，答「我家附近的一家店」。「I prefer to stand…」用 stand 做同字陷阱；「It adjusts to almost any height」由站立式書桌聯想到功能，沒回答在哪裡買。

l2.q: Where are we meeting the investors on Monday?
opts: Their assistant is still booking a place.
l2.exp: Where 問週一在哪裡和投資人見面，間接回答「他們的助理還在訂地點」。「At ten, before lunch」答的是時間；「invested」和 investors 同字根，是相關字陷阱。

l2.q: Where do I drop off the rental car?
opts: In the lot across from Terminal B.
l2.exp: Where 問租來的車在哪裡還，答「B 航廈對面的停車場」。「It's a compact car」只是由 car 聯想到車型；「drop by」（順道過去）和 drop off 同字不同義。

l2.q: Why did the bank call you this morning?
opts: I'll call you back this afternoon.
l2.exp: Why 問銀行今早為什麼打電話來，答「要確認最近的一筆付款」，用 To 不定詞表示目的。「Shortly after nine thirty」答的是何時；「I'll call you back…」用 call 做同字陷阱。

l2.q: Why is Ines working from home this week?
opts: She's waiting for some furniture deliveries.
She works on the design team.
l2.exp: Why 問 Ines 這週為什麼在家工作，答「她在等家具送貨」。「She works on the design team」重複 work，但說的是她在哪個部門；「Mostly on Tuesdays…」答的是哪幾天，不是原因。

l2.q: Why did the restaurant change its menu?
opts: The new chef wanted lighter dishes.
I'll have the soup of the day, please.
It opens at eleven every weekday morning.
l2.exp: Why 問餐廳為什麼換菜單，答「新主廚想做比較清淡的菜」。「I'll have the soup…」是點餐用語，只由 menu 聯想；「It opens at eleven…」答的是營業時間。

l2.q: How did you hear about this position?
opts: I can hear you much more clearly now.
l2.exp: How did you hear 問（面試時）怎麼得知這個職缺，答「以前的同事推薦的」。「The position is full-time」重複 position 但沒回答管道；「I can hear you much more clearly」的 hear 是「聽得到聲音」，同字不同義。

l2.q: How many welcome kits should we order for the seminar?
l2.exp: How many 問研討會要訂幾份迎賓包，間接回答「等報名截止再說」（到時才知道人數）。「kitchen」和 kit 發音相近；「It was a helpful seminar」用過去式評論研討會，答非所問。

l2.q: How much time should I set aside for the interview?
opts: Just set it aside on my desk.
l2.exp: How much time 問面試要預留多少時間（set aside），答「大約一小時就夠了」。「set it aside on my desk」的 set aside 是「放在旁邊」，同字不同義；「The interviewer seemed…」由 interview 聯想到面試官。

l2.q: How do you like working at the new site?
opts: I'd like a large one, please.
l2.exp: How do you like 問對新工作地點的感想，答「通勤方便多了」。「I'd like a large one」用 like 做同字陷阱（意思是「想要」）；「website」和 site 是拆字音近陷阱。

l2.q: Which train should I take to the Westfield office?
opts: Any of the express lines will do.
l2.exp: Which 問去 Westfield 辦公室該搭哪班車，答「任何一條快線都可以」。「take notes」用 take 做同字陷阱；「The office closes at six」重複 office，答的是時間。

l2.q: Which of the candidates impressed you the most?
l2.exp: Which of the candidates 問哪位應徵者最讓人印象深刻，答「毫無疑問是 Nakamura 小姐」。「impressive building」用 impress 的同字根做陷阱；「Mostly for sales positions」由應徵者聯想到職缺，沒指出是哪一位。

l2.q: Have you tried the new scheduling app yet?
opts: Not yet, but I've heard good things.
I'll try to be there by noon.
The schedule was posted on Monday morning.
l2.exp: 問用過新的排程 App 沒，答「還沒，但聽說不錯」。「I'll try to be there」的 try 是「盡量」，同字不同義；「The schedule was posted…」由 scheduling 聯想到班表，答非所問。

l2.q: Is the gym on the ground floor open to all employees?
opts: I opened a new account there.
Yes, the floor was just mopped.
l2.exp: 問一樓健身房是否開放給全體員工，答「要先登記才可以」。「I opened a new account」用 open 做同字陷阱；「Yes, the floor was just mopped」雖然有 Yes，但說的是地板剛拖過，用 floor 做同字陷阱。

l2.q: Did the courier come by for the legal documents?
opts: The package is still at reception.
l2.exp: 問快遞有沒有來收法律文件，間接回答「包裹還在櫃檯」（＝還沒來收）。「He's a lawyer」由 legal 聯想到律師；「documentary」（紀錄片）和 documents 發音相近，是音近陷阱。

l2.q: Will the store be open on the national holiday?
opts: I stored them in the basement.
We had a wonderful holiday in Spain.
l2.exp: 問國定假日店有沒有開，答「只開到那天下午三點」（＝有開，但時間縮短）。「stored」是動詞「存放」，和 store（商店）同字不同義；「We had a wonderful holiday」用過去式談假期，答非所問。

l2.q: Didn't you use to work in the Lisbon office?
opts: The office is closed on Fridays.
l2.exp: 否定問句確認對方以前是否在里斯本辦公室工作，答「對，大約兩年」。「The office is closed…」重複 office 但沒回答；「It works perfectly」的 work 是「運作」，同字不同義。

l2.q: Isn't Mr. Fischer retiring at the end of the year?
opts: At the end of the hallway.
l2.exp: 否定問句確認 Fischer 先生是否年底退休，間接回答「聽說他改變心意了」（＝不退休了）。「tire」和 retiring 的後半發音相近；「At the end of the hallway」重複 the end of，答的是地點。

l2.q: Shouldn't the caterers be here by now?
l2.exp: 否定問句表示外燴人員早該到了，答「他們正在停車」（＝已經到了）。「I've been here since nine」重複 here，說的是自己；「Here's the menu we chose」由外燴聯想到菜單，沒回答是否到了。

l2.q: The new hires start orientation tomorrow, don't they?
opts: HR is still finalizing the schedule.
l2.exp: 附加問句確認新進員工（new hires）是否明天開始新人訓練，間接回答「人資還在敲定時程」（＝還不確定）。「higher」和 hires 發音相近；「hired a moving company」的 hire 是「雇用搬家公司」，同字不同情境。

l2.q: You haven't seen my reading glasses, have you?
opts: Did you check the conference room?
Yes, I read it last night.
l2.exp: 附加問句問有沒有看到自己的老花眼鏡，用反問「你找過會議室了嗎？」間接回答（暗示可能放在那裡）。「I read it last night」用 read 做同字陷阱；「A glass of water」的 glass 是「玻璃杯」，同字不同義。

l2.q: This bus goes to the art museum, right?
opts: Yes, it stops right out front.
The art supplies are in the closet.
l2.exp: 附加問句（…, right?）確認這班公車是否到美術館，答「對，就停在正門口」。「art supplies」用 art 做同字陷阱；「The exhibit opens in May」由 museum 聯想到展覽，沒回答公車路線。

l2.q: Has IT installed the new firewall yet?
opts: The fire drill is at ten o'clock.
l2.exp: 問資訊部裝好新的防火牆（firewall）了沒，答「他們週末會裝」（＝還沒）。「fire drill」（消防演習）用 fire 做拆字陷阱；「It's a very well-run department」由 IT 聯想到部門，答非所問。

l2.q: Do you know if Ms. Reyes accepted the job offer?
opts: She asked for a few more days.
She offered me a ride home.
Yes, I know the job well.
l2.exp: 間接問句問 Reyes 小姐有沒有接受工作邀約，間接回答「她要求再多給幾天」（＝還沒決定）。「offered me a ride」用 offer 做同字陷阱；「Yes, I know the job well」重複 know 和 job，但回答的是自己熟不熟悉這份工作。

l2.q: Should we hold the retreat in the mountains or by the coast?
opts: The coast is easier to reach.
Yes, I'd love to go there sometime.
Hold on, let me grab a pen first.
l2.exp: 選擇問句問員工旅遊辦在山上還是海邊，答「海邊比較好到達」＝選海邊。選擇問句不能用 Yes 回答；「Hold on」（等一下）用 hold 做同字陷阱。

l2.q: Do you want to pay now or when you pick up the order?
opts: Yes, I paid it in full last week.
l2.exp: 選擇問句問現在付款還是取貨時付，答「取貨時再付」。「Yes, I paid it in full last week」用 Yes 回答選擇問句，時態也不對；「Pick any color」的 pick 是「挑選」，和 pick up 同字不同義。

l2.q: Are you taking the early flight or the one at noon?
l2.exp: 選擇問句問搭早班還是中午的班機，答「其實我要開車去」，兩個都不選，是常見的高分正解型態。「It's about a two-hour flight」答的是飛多久；「Yes, I'll take it」用 Yes 回答選擇問句。

l2.q: Would you rather review the contract yourself, or should I send it to legal?
opts: Legal should probably see it first.
The view from here is great.
l2.exp: 選擇問句問要自己看合約，還是送法務部，答「最好先給法務看」＝選送法務。「It's a two-year contract」重複 contract 但沒做選擇；「view」和 review 是拆字音近陷阱。

l2.q: Should I print the name badges, or is the venue making them?
opts: The venue said they'd handle them.
My name is spelled with a K, not a C.
l2.exp: 選擇問句問名牌要自己印還是場地方製作，答「場地方說他們會處理」＝選場地方。「My name is spelled…」用 name 做同字陷阱；「About one hundred and twenty」答的是數量。

l2.q: Should we repaint the office or just replace the carpet?
opts: Let's see what the budget allows.
I painted my kitchen last month, too.
Yes, it's such a lovely, bright office.
l2.exp: 選擇問句問辦公室要重新粉刷還是只換地毯，間接回答「看預算允許做到哪裡」。「I painted my kitchen」用 paint 做同字陷阱；「Yes, it's such a lovely, bright office」用 Yes 回答選擇問句。

l2.q: Did Mr. Haddad want the window table or the private room?
opts: The window by the door won't open.
I'll set the table for them now.
l2.exp: 選擇問句問 Haddad 先生要靠窗的桌子還是包廂，間接回答「他其實沒特別說」。「The window by the door won't open」用 window 做同字陷阱；「I'll set the table for them」用 table 做同字陷阱（擺餐具）。

l2.q: Will you take the job in Toronto or stay here?
opts: It takes about an hour by train.
Yes, I'll stay for dinner tonight.
l2.exp: 選擇問句問要接多倫多的工作還是留下，間接回答「我還在考慮那個工作邀約」（weigh＝衡量）。「It takes about an hour」用 take 做同字陷阱；「Yes, I'll stay for dinner」用 Yes 回答，stay 也是同字不同情境。

l2.q: Could you take notes during the client call?
opts: I took the call at noon.
Please leave a note on my desk.
l2.exp: 請求對方在客戶電話會議時做筆記，答「好，我帶筆電去」＝答應。「I took the call at noon」用 take／call 做同字陷阱；「leave a note」用 note 做同字陷阱（留字條），反過來要求對方。

l2.q: Would you mind turning the music down a little?
opts: Sorry, I didn't realize it was loud.
The music store closes at eight.
Turn left at the next corner.
l2.exp: Would you mind 請對方把音樂調小聲，答「抱歉，我沒發現這麼大聲」＝會調小。「The music store…」用 music 做同字陷阱；「Turn left…」用 turn 做同字陷阱（轉彎）。

l2.q: Do you want me to proofread the proposal before it goes out?
opts: I proposed the idea last week.
l2.exp: 提議幫忙校對（proofread）提案，間接婉拒「Ravi 已經看過了，謝謝」。「proposed」和 proposal 同字根；「went out of business」（倒閉）用 go out 做同字不同義陷阱。

l2.q: Why don't I set up the video call for you?
opts: Thanks, I'm not great with that software.
l2.exp: Why don't I… 是提議幫忙設定視訊會議，不是問原因；答「謝謝，我不太會用那個軟體」＝接受。「Because…」把提議誤當成問原因，camera 也只是相關字聯想；「I called you twice」用 call 做同字陷阱。

l2.q: Would you like to join our book club?
opts: I booked a table for six.
l2.exp: 邀請對方加入讀書會，用反問「什麼時候聚會？」間接回應（先問時間再決定）。「booked」（預訂）和 book（書）同字不同義；「It's a very long novel」只是由讀書會聯想到小說，沒回應邀請。

l2.q: We're having a farewell lunch for Akiko on Friday. Can you come?
opts: I'll be at a client site, unfortunately.
l2.exp: 邀請對方週五參加 Akiko 的歡送午餐，答「很可惜，我那天要去客戶那裡」＝婉拒。「The lunch menu…」重複 lunch 但沒回應邀請；「Friday's forecast…」重複 Friday，說的是天氣。

l2.q: Let's ask the vendor for a discount.
opts: The vendor's booth is near the exit.
l2.exp: Let's 提議向廠商要折扣，答「值得試試看」＝贊成。「counted」和 discount 的後半發音相近；「The vendor's booth…」重複 vendor，說的是攤位位置。

l2.q: How about moving the team meeting to the morning?
opts: Half the team is in training then.
l2.exp: How about 提議把團隊會議改到早上，間接回應「那時候一半的人在受訓」（＝不太可行）。「Good morning」用 morning 做同字陷阱；「It meets in Room Four」答的是地點，沒回應提議。

l2.q: Can you show the new accountant where everything is?
opts: Sure, once I finish this e-mail.
The account was closed last year.
l2.exp: 請對方帶新會計認識環境，答「好，等我寫完這封信」＝答應。「Everything is on sale」重複 everything；「account」和 accountant 是拆字陷阱。

l2.q: The air in this room feels a bit stuffy.
opts: Should I prop the door open?
It's the biggest room on this floor.
l2.exp: 說房間有點悶（stuffy），用反問「要不要我把門撐開？」回應，提出解決方法。「Air travel…」用 air 做同字陷阱；「It's the biggest room…」重複 room，沒回應悶熱的問題。

l2.q: I'm afraid we've run out of blue folders.
l2.exp: 說藍色資料夾用完了（run out of），答「綠色的也可以」。「folded」（摺）和 folders 發音相近；「We'll be out until three」的 out 是「外出」，同字不同義。

l2.q: The new coffee machine is much easier to use.
opts: And it's a lot quieter, too.
l2.exp: 稱讚新咖啡機好用多了，附和「而且也安靜很多」。「Use the side entrance」用 use 做同字陷阱；「Two sugars, please」由 coffee 聯想到點咖啡，答非所問。

l2.q: Our sales numbers dropped in the northern region.
opts: I dropped it off this morning.
l2.exp: 說北區業績下滑，用反問「有人查過原因嗎？」回應。「dropped it off」（送過去）用 drop 做同字不同義陷阱；「Head north…」由 northern 聯想到方向，是在指路。

l2.q: I still haven't heard back from the hotel about our group rate.
opts: A group of twelve, I think.
l2.exp: 說飯店一直沒回覆團體房價，建議「也許直接打電話給他們」。「growth rate」用 rate 做同字陷阱；「A group of twelve」用 group 做同字陷阱，答的是人數。

l2.q: The museum's closed for a private event today.
opts: Then let's visit the gardens instead.
It closes at five on weekdays.
The event was a huge success.
l2.exp: 說博物館今天因私人活動閉館，回應「那我們改去逛花園吧」。「It closes at five…」由 closed 聯想到閉館時間，但今天根本沒開；「The event was a huge success」用過去式評論活動，和「今天正在辦」對不上。

l2.q: I've never been to the Madrid office before.
opts: The office supplies are running low.
l2.exp: 說自己沒去過馬德里辦公室，回應「我可以把路線傳給你」。「The office supplies…」重複 office；「It was never delivered」重複 never，答非所問。

l2.q: Our competitor just lowered their prices.
opts: Do you know by how much?
l2.exp: 說競爭對手剛降價，用反問「你知道降了多少嗎？」回應。「Lower the volume」用 lower 做同字陷阱（調低音量）；「competition」（比賽）和 competitor 同字根，答的是時間。

l2.q: Someone left an umbrella in the meeting room.
opts: Put it in the lost and found.
It might rain later this afternoon.
l2.exp: 說有人把傘留在會議室，回應「放到失物招領處吧」。「It might rain…」由 umbrella 聯想到下雨；「The room holds about twenty」重複 room，說的是容納人數。

l34.title: 對話：人行道座位許可

turns.t: Hi, I own Bluebird Café on Maple Street. I applied for a sidewalk seating permit three weeks ago, and I still haven't heard anything back.
Let me look it up. Yes, here it is. It was put on hold because the site drawing you attached doesn't show how far the tables would be from the curb.
Oh, I didn't realize that was required. We were hoping to have tables outside before the street festival on the twenty-fourth.
That's still possible. If you send a revised drawing this week, an inspector can review it within five business days.
Great. Can I e-mail it, or do I have to bring it in?
E-mail is fine. I'll send you a link to the upload page right now, along with an example of a completed drawing.

qs.q: What is the woman inquiring about?
opts: The date of a local street festival
A complaint from a neighboring shop
qs.exp: 女士說三週前申請了人行道座位許可，到現在都沒消息＝詢問申請的進度。street festival 只是她希望趕上的時間點，不是詢問的主題；家具價格和鄰居抱怨都沒有提到。

qs.q: What was missing from the woman's application?
opts: Details about where tables would go
A signature from the property owner
qs.exp: 男士說附上的配置圖沒標出桌子離路緣（curb）多遠＝缺少桌子擺放位置的細節。屋主簽名、保險證明、手續費都沒有提到。

qs.q: What will the man send the woman?
opts: A sample of a finished drawing
A schedule for the street festival
qs.exp: 男士說會寄上傳頁面的連結，再附一份填好的配置圖範例（an example of a completed drawing）＝完成圖的範本。inspector 是審查的人，他沒說要寄名單；活動時程和收據都沒提。

l34.title: 對話：產品手冊翻譯報價

turns.t: Hello, this is Gareth Moore from Hartwell Appliances. We've just finished the user manual for our new coffee machine, and we need it translated into Spanish and Portuguese.
Certainly. How long is the manual?
About forty pages, but much of it is diagrams, so roughly twelve thousand words in total.
For that length, we'd normally need three weeks for both languages. Is there a particular deadline?
The first machines ship to our distributors in Brazil on the fifth of next month, so time is quite tight.
In that case, I'd suggest we do the Portuguese version first and deliver the Spanish one a week later. I'll put a quote together and send it over this afternoon.

qs.q: What does the man want to have done?
opts: Product instructions put into other languages
Diagrams redrawn for a new catalog
A shipment sent to Brazil ahead of schedule
qs.exp: 男士說新咖啡機的使用手冊（user manual）要翻成西班牙文和葡萄牙文＝把產品說明翻成其他語言。咖啡機是產品本身，沒有要修；手冊裡有圖表，但沒說要重畫；出貨到巴西是期限，不是委託的事。

qs.q: Why does the woman suggest completing the Portuguese version first?
opts: It is needed for the earliest shipment
It is shorter than the Spanish version
Her agency has more Portuguese translators
The distributors asked for it in writing
qs.exp: 推論：男士說第一批機器下個月五號要出貨到巴西，巴西用葡萄牙文，所以女士建議先做葡萄牙文版＝最早出貨要用到。兩種版本長度、譯者人數、經銷商書面要求都沒有提到。

qs.q: What will the woman do this afternoon?
opts: Assign the job to a translator
qs.exp: 女士最後說 I'll put a quote together and send it over this afternoon＝今天下午寄報價（quote＝price estimate）。看圖表、聯絡巴西經銷商、分派譯者都沒有說。

l34.title: 對話：員工流感疫苗日（三人對話）

turns.t: Thanks for coming in, Mr. Lopez. We're excited to offer free flu shots to our employees this year.
Happy to help. Our nurses can vaccinate about sixty people in a morning. How many have signed up so far?
Eighty-five. Brian, is the training room free on the fourteenth?
It's booked that morning for the new-hire session, but it's open all afternoon. The third-floor lounge is free all day, though.
Then let's use the lounge in the morning and the training room in the afternoon. That way we can see everyone in one day.
Perfect. I'll send staff a sign-up sheet with time slots so we don't end up with long lines.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the meeting?
opts: To organize a health event for employees
To choose a new insurance provider
To interview candidates for a nursing job
qs.exp: 女士說今年要提供員工免費流感疫苗，三人在討論場地和時間＝籌辦員工健康活動。新人說明會只是訓練室早上被占用的原因；保險和面試護理師都沒有提到。

qs.q: Why is the training room unavailable in the morning?
opts: It has been reserved for another session
It is being repainted that day
It is too small for the nurses
It is needed for a staff party
qs.exp: Brian 說訓練室那天早上已經預約給新進員工說明會（booked … for the new-hire session）＝被另一個活動預約。油漆、空間太小、員工派對都沒有提到。

qs.q: What can be inferred about the number of employees who signed up?
opts: It is lower than the woman expected
It includes family members of staff
It must be confirmed by the fourteenth
qs.exp: 推論：護士一個早上大約只能打六十人，但已經有八十五人報名，所以要用一整天、兩個場地＝超過一個早上能處理的人數。女士沒有說人數比預期少，也沒提到家屬或確認期限。

l34.title: 對話：倉庫盤點短少（意圖題）

turns.t: Callum, last night's stock count doesn't match our system. The records show two hundred desk lamps, but the team only counted a hundred and sixty.
Forty missing? That's odd. Has anyone checked the returns area? Damaged items sometimes sit there before they're logged.
I hadn't thought of that. The trouble is, we've got an order for a hundred and eighty lamps going out to a retailer tomorrow.
Well, the supplier's van comes on Thursdays.
And today's Thursday. Good thinking. I'll ring them now and ask them to add thirty lamps to this afternoon's delivery, just to be safe.
Great. And I'll go and look through the returns area myself.

qs.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?
opts: Fewer items were counted than expected
A retailer has canceled an order
The inventory system has stopped working
qs.exp: 系統紀錄有兩百盞檯燈，但盤點只數到一百六十盞＝實際數到的比預期少。損壞品只是男士猜測可能放在退貨區；零售商的訂單還在，沒有取消；系統沒有故障，只是數字對不上。

qs.q: What does the man imply when he says, "the supplier's van comes on Thursdays"?
opts: More lamps could arrive before the order ships
The stock count was done on the wrong day
The supplier is to blame for the shortage
Deliveries should be moved to another day
qs.exp: 意圖題：女士擔心明天要出一百八十盞，但庫存不夠；男士提醒供應商週四會來送貨，暗示今天就能補貨、趕在出貨前到。女士馬上回應今天就是週四，要打電話請對方多送五十盞。他沒有怪供應商，也沒說盤點日期或送貨日要改。

qs.q: What will the man do next?
opts: Search one section of the warehouse
Tell the retailer about a delay
qs.exp: 男士最後說他要親自去退貨區找（look through the returns area myself）＝搜查倉庫的一區。打電話給供應商是女士要做的事；更新紀錄和通知零售商延誤都沒有提到。

l34.title: 對話：停車場充電樁

turns.t: Hi, Ms. Chen. Several of our employees have bought electric cars, and they've asked whether we could get charging stations in the parking garage.
Actually, the building owners have been looking into that. An electrician came last week to check whether the garage's power supply could handle it.
And could it?
For up to six stations, yes. The owners would pay for the installation, but tenants would cover the electricity through a small monthly fee.
That seems fair. How soon could they be put in?
Probably in early spring. In the meantime, could you find out how many of your staff would actually use them? That'll help us decide where to put them.

qs.q: Who most likely is the woman?
qs.exp: 推論：她代表大樓業主說明安裝計畫、費用怎麼分攤、租戶要付月費，還要決定充電樁放哪裡＝大樓物業管理人員。電工是上週來檢查的另一個人；她沒有賣車，也不是停車場收費員。

qs.q: According to the woman, who would pay for the electricity?
opts: Each driver at the time of charging
qs.exp: 女士說業主出安裝費，電費由租戶（tenants）以小額月費支付。業主負責的是安裝；電力公司沒提；是按月收費，不是每次充電時由駕駛付。

qs.q: What does the woman ask the man to do?
opts: Check how many staff would use the chargers
Get a quote from an electrician
Pay a deposit for the installation
qs.exp: 女士請他了解公司有多少員工真的會用（find out how many of your staff would actually use them）。電工已經來過；訪客車位和訂金都沒有提到。

l34.title: 對話：分派暑期實習生（三人對話）

turns.t: Our three summer interns start on Monday. Oliver, Hannah, I'd like each of you to supervise one of them.
I could use someone on the customer database. Half the addresses in it are out of date.
And I'd love some help with the social media calendar. We've fallen behind on posts since Leah went on leave.
Good. Then the third intern can assist with the annual report, and I'll supervise that one myself.
Should we prepare anything for their first day?
Yes. Please write a one-page outline of your intern's tasks and send it to me by Friday, so I can add it to their welcome packs.

qs.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
opts: How to assign work to new interns
qs.exp: 主管說三位暑期實習生週一報到，請兩人各帶一位，接著討論每位實習生要做什麼＝分派實習生的工作。資料庫和年報只是其中兩項工作；Leah 是請假，沒有要找人取代。

qs.q: What is implied about the company's social media posts?
opts: They have not been published regularly
They will be written by Leah
They were moved to a new platform
qs.exp: 推論：Hannah 說自從 Leah 請假，貼文進度就落後了（fallen behind on posts）＝最近沒有按時發布。回應多寡、換平台都沒提；Leah 正在請假，不會由她來寫。

qs.q: What are Oliver and Hannah asked to do by Friday?
qs.exp: 主管請他們寫一頁實習生工作大綱（outline of your intern's tasks），週五前交給她＝說明實習生的職責。歡迎資料袋是主管自己要整理的；實習生已錄取，不用面試；貼文行事曆不是週五前的指定工作。

l34.title: 對話：店面天花板漏水

turns.t: Mr. Grant, it's Alicia Ramos at the shoe store. Water is dripping from the ceiling near our fitting area again. It started during last night's storm.
I'm sorry to hear that. The roofers told me they'd repaired that section in August. Has any merchandise been damaged?
A few display boxes got wet, but I moved most of our stock into the back room. The real problem is that I've had to close off half the sales floor, and it's a Saturday.
I understand. I'll have a different roofing company come out this afternoon to take a look, and I'll cover the cost of anything that was ruined.
Thanks. I'll take photos of the boxes and send you a list.

qs.q: Who most likely is the man?
qs.exp: 推論：女士向他報告店裡天花板漏水，他說之前請屋頂工人修過，還要另外找屋頂公司、負擔損失＝出租店面的房東。屋頂工人是他請的人，不是他本人；顧客和供應商不會處理建物維修。

qs.q: What does the woman say she has done?
opts: Closed the store for the day
qs.exp: 她說把大部分商品搬到後面的倉庫（moved most of our stock into the back room）＝移動商品。她只封了半個賣場，沒有關店；找屋頂公司是男士要做的；拍照是她之後才要拍，而且拍的是鞋盒，不是天花板。

qs.q: What does the man say he will do?
opts: Send another firm to inspect the roof
Visit the store himself this afternoon
Repair the ceiling on his own
qs.exp: 男士說今天下午會請另一家屋頂公司來看（a different roofing company come out … to take a look）。來的是屋頂公司，不是他本人；他說會賠償損壞的東西，但沒有提到減租；也沒說要自己修。

l34.title: 對話：報稅資料補件

turns.t: Hello, Ms. Okafor. It's Neil from Barrow and Finch Accounting. I'm working on your tax return, and I've noticed something missing.
Oh dear. I've had so many design projects for clients this year that I've barely had time to sort out my paperwork.
You've sent all your invoices, but there are no receipts for the computer equipment you bought in March. If you can show those, you can deduct the cost.
I ordered it all online, so the receipts should be in my e-mail somewhere.
That's fine. Just forward them to me. The filing deadline is the end of the month, but I'd like everything by next Wednesday so there's time to check it.
No problem. I'll go through my inbox tonight.

qs.q: What kind of work does the woman most likely do?
qs.exp: 推論：她說今年替客戶做了很多設計案（design projects for clients），還開立發票＝從事設計服務。會計是男士的工作；電腦是她買的設備；她是在網路上買東西，不是在網路上賣東西。

qs.q: What does the man say is missing?
qs.exp: 男士說三月買電腦設備的收據（receipts）沒有寄來＝購買證明。發票都已經寄了；去年的報稅資料和簽名表格都沒有提到。

qs.q: What will the woman do tonight?
qs.exp: 女士說今晚會翻找收件匣（go through my inbox）＝查看電子郵件。她不用去事務所；設備是三月就買了；報稅是會計師處理，期限在月底。

l34.title: 對話：飯店大廳開幕花藝

turns.t: Fernwood Flowers, this is Grace speaking.
Hi, Grace. It's Daniel at the Kingsley Hotel. We're reopening our lobby after the renovation on the ninth, and we'd like some large arrangements for the front desk and the entrance.
Lovely. Do you have any colors in mind?
The new interior is mostly gray and navy, so something white with plenty of green would work well. Nothing with a strong scent, though. Some of our guests are sensitive to it.
Then I'd stay away from lilies. White roses and hydrangeas would be a good choice. Could I stop by on Monday to measure the spaces?
Sure. Any time after ten is fine.

qs.q: Why is the man calling?
opts: To order flowers for a reopening
To book a room for a guest
To complain about a late delivery
qs.exp: 男士說飯店大廳整修後要重新開幕，想訂大型花藝擺在櫃台和入口＝為重新開幕訂花。整修已經完成，他沒有問費用；訂房和延遲送貨都沒有提到。

qs.q: What does the man ask the woman to avoid?
qs.exp: 他說不要香味太濃的（Nothing with a strong scent），因為有些客人會過敏＝避開氣味強烈的花。他只說白色配綠色很適合，沒有說不能用紅色；高度和澆水都沒提。

qs.q: What is suggested about lilies?
opts: They are not available in white
They are too costly for the order
They do not last long in a lobby
qs.exp: 推論：男士剛說不要香味濃的花，女士馬上說那就不用百合＝暗示百合香味很重。顏色、價格、能放多久都沒有提到。

l34.title: 對話：煞車線品質不良

turns.t: Hello, Mr. Dixon. This is Fiona Walsh at Kestrel Bikes. I'm afraid around thirty of the brake cables in your last shipment failed our quality tests. They snapped under far less tension than they're rated for.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Were they all from the same batch?
Yes, the labels all show the same batch number. We've stopped using them, but it's holding up our production line.
I'll have replacements sent by express courier today, at no charge. Could you also send a few of the faulty cables back to us? Our engineers will want to find out what went wrong.
Of course. I'll package five of them this afternoon.

qs.q: Where does the man most likely work?
opts: At a company that supplies parts
qs.exp: 推論：女士說他上一批出貨的煞車線不合格，他答應免費寄替換品，還請對方把瑕疵品寄回給工程師分析＝零件供應商。快遞只是寄送方式；品質測試是女士公司做的；自行車店不會大量出貨零件給製造商。

qs.q: What does the woman say about the faulty cables?
opts: They all came from one batch
They were cut to the wrong length
qs.exp: 女士說標籤上都是同一個批號（the same batch number）＝都來自同一批。問題是拉力測試沒過，不是運送損壞、長度錯誤或遲到。

qs.q: What will the woman do this afternoon?
qs.exp: 她說今天下午會包裝五條（package five of them）寄回去＝準備寄出一些線材。產線還要等替換品；快遞費由男士負擔（at no charge）；替換品還沒到，無法測試。

l34.title: 對話：辦公室清潔方案（圖表題）

turns.t: Our cleaning contract ends this month, and I've got the new price list from Sparkle Pro. Right now someone comes in twice a week, but the kitchen's a mess by Wednesday.
Since we hired the new sales team, there are a lot more people in the office. I think we need more frequent visits.
A visit every weekday would be ideal, but that plan is way over our budget. We can spend up to five hundred dollars a month.
Then let's go with three visits a week. That should keep things under control.
Agreed. I'll call Sparkle Pro this afternoon to sign us up. Could you put a notice in the kitchen asking people to wash their own cups?

qs.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
qs.exp: 兩人看著清潔公司的價目表，討論要每週來幾次、預算多少＝選擇服務方案。新業務團隊只是人變多的原因；廚房髒亂不是要整修；預算是上限，不是要刪減。

qs.q: Look at the graphic. Which plan will the speakers most likely choose?
qs.exp: 圖表題：他們決定每週三次（three visits a week），表上每週三次的是 Plus，月費 450，也在五百元預算內。Standard 是現在的每週兩次；Premium 是每個平日都來，超出預算；Basic 只有一次。

qs.q: What does the woman ask the man to do?
qs.exp: 女士請他在廚房貼告示，提醒大家自己洗杯子（put a notice in the kitchen）＝張貼提醒。打電話給清潔公司是女士自己要做的；他不用親自打掃，也沒被要求檢查預算。

l34.title: 對話：租用倉儲空間（圖表題）

turns.t: Kingsway Storage, how can I help?
Hello. I run a small theatre company, and our rehearsal hall is being refurbished for three months. We need somewhere to keep our costumes and some scenery.
How much space are you thinking of?
The scenery panels are quite tall, but a unit of three metres by three metres should be enough. We'll be coming in most days to collect things for performances, though.
Then I'd recommend one on the ground floor. The lift to the first floor is fairly small, so getting large items up there can be a struggle.
That makes sense. Could I come and see it this afternoon?
Certainly. Just bring some photo ID, and we can sign the agreement at the same time.

qs.q: What is implied about the scenery panels?
opts: They would be hard to take upstairs
They will be used in a new production
They were damaged in a recent performance
qs.exp: 推論：男士說布景板很高，女士接著說通往 first floor（英式用法，指地面層的上一層）的電梯很小、大件物品很難搬上去，所以推薦地面層＝布景板很難搬上樓。溫控、新劇碼、演出時損壞都沒有提到。

qs.q: Look at the graphic. Which unit will the man most likely rent?
qs.exp: 圖表題：他要三乘三公尺、又要在地面層（ground floor），表上符合兩個條件的是 B18。B12 太小；C05 雖然也是三乘三，但在 first floor；C21 尺寸和樓層都不對。

qs.q: What does the woman ask the man to bring?
opts: A copy of his signed contract
A deposit for the first month
qs.exp: 女士請他帶有照片的證件（photo ID）＝身分證明。合約是到現場才簽，不用帶來；押金和布景尺寸都沒有被要求。

l34.graphic:

B18    3m x 3m   Ground floor

l34.title: 獨白：面試通知語音留言（意圖題）

turns.t: Hello, Mr. Alvarez. This is Monica Reyes from the recruiting team at Tilden Engineering. Thank you for applying for the project coordinator position. We were impressed by your application, and we'd like to invite you to a final interview with our operations director next Tuesday at ten thirty. The interview will take about an hour, and you'll also be asked to give a short presentation on a project you've managed. I know that's not a lot of notice. If the time doesn't suit you, we have one other opening on Thursday afternoon. Either way, please call me back at five five five, two zero one eight by tomorrow, so I can confirm the booking with the director.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the message?
opts: To offer the listener a position
To request a written project report
qs.exp: 留言說邀請對方參加最終面試（a final interview），並說明時間＝安排工作面試。還沒錄取，不是提供職位；簡報是面試的一部分，不是要書面報告，也沒指定主題。

qs.q: What does the speaker imply when she says, "I know that's not a lot of notice"?
opts: The timing may be inconvenient for the listener
The position was filled sooner than planned
The presentation should be kept very brief
She only recently learned of the vacancy
qs.exp: 意圖題：她才通知下週二面試，還要準備簡報，接著說如果時間不方便還有週四下午可選＝她知道這個時間可能對聽者不方便。職位還在徵才，不是提早補滿；簡報長短不是這句的重點；她也沒說自己是最近才知道有職缺。

qs.q: What is the listener asked to do by tomorrow?
qs.exp: 她請對方明天之前回電（call me back … by tomorrow），好跟主管確認時間。和營運主管見面是面試當天的事；簡報範例和推薦人名單都沒有要求。

l34.title: 獨白：電梯保養公告（圖表題）

turns.t: Good morning, everyone. This is Martin from facilities with a quick reminder about next week's lift maintenance. As you can see on the schedule posted by the lifts, each one will be out of service for a full day while engineers replace its control panel. Now, the goods lift is the only one large enough for the catering trolleys, so on the day it's closed, lunch will be served in the ground-floor meeting room instead of the staff restaurant upstairs. Also, please avoid booking visitors before noon on that day, as the remaining lifts will be very busy. Thanks for your patience, and if you have any questions, ring the facilities desk on extension four one two.

qs.q: What is the announcement mainly about?
opts: Planned work on the building's lifts
A new menu in the staff restaurant
qs.exp: 公告說下週每部電梯會停用一整天，更換控制面板＝電梯的預定維修工程。餐廳只是午餐地點暫時改變，菜單沒變；訪客停車沒提；換的是電梯控制面板，不是保全面板。

qs.q: Look at the graphic. On which day will lunch be served on the ground floor?
qs.exp: 圖表題：午餐改在一樓的那天是貨梯（goods lift）停用的日子，表上貨梯是 Lift D，排在 Thursday 22。其他三天停的是一般客梯，午餐照常在樓上員工餐廳。

qs.q: What are listeners asked to avoid?
opts: Scheduling morning visitors on one day
Using the stairs during the work
qs.exp: 他請大家在那天中午前不要安排訪客（avoid booking visitors before noon on that day）＝那一天上午不要約訪客。走樓梯、帶食物進電梯、直接找工程師都沒有提到；有問題是打分機給設備組。

Lift D (Goods) ... Thursday 22

l34.title: 獨白：眼鏡行廣播廣告

turns.t: Is it time for a new pair of glasses? At Clearview Optical, we make it easy. Our certified eye doctors offer free eye exams with the purchase of any complete pair of glasses, and most orders are ready in just one hour, while you shop. This month only, we're celebrating the opening of our fourth location, at Lakeside Mall, by offering a second pair of frames at half price. And if you're not sure which style suits you, try the new virtual mirror on our Web site. Just upload a photo and see how hundreds of frames look on your face. Clearview Optical. We'll help you see the difference.

qs.q: What is being advertised?
qs.exp: 廣告介紹 Clearview Optical 賣眼鏡、提供驗光＝眼鏡行。Lakeside Mall 只是新分店的地點；驗光是附加服務，不是診所廣告；上傳照片是網站上的試戴功能。

qs.q: Why is the business offering a discount this month?
opts: It is clearing out old frames
It has redesigned its Web site
qs.exp: 廣告說這個月為了慶祝第四家分店開幕（celebrating the opening of our fourth location），第二副鏡框半價＝新分店開幕。週年慶、出清舊貨都沒提；網站是新增試戴功能，不是折扣的原因。

qs.q: What is implied about Clearview Optical?
opts: It already operates three other stores
It has recently hired new eye doctors
Its glasses usually take a week to make
It charges a fee for every eye exam
qs.exp: 推論：新開的是第四家店，所以之前已經有三家＝已經有另外三家店。驗光師沒說是新聘的；大部分眼鏡一小時就好，不是一週；買整副眼鏡就免費驗光，不是每次都收費。

l34.title: 獨白：植物園溫室導覽

turns.t: Welcome to the Tropical House here at Ashcombe Botanic Gardens. My name's Rachel, and I'll be your guide for the next forty minutes. This glasshouse was built in eighteen sixty-two and is home to more than three thousand plant species from rainforests around the world. It's kept at around twenty-eight degrees, so you might like to take off your coats and hang them on the rack by the door. As we walk, please stay on the paths, as some of the plants are quite delicate. Our first stop is the giant water lily pond, just through this archway. Its leaves can grow more than two metres wide. After the tour, do visit our shop, where you can buy seeds of many plants you'll see today.

qs.q: Where most likely are the listeners?
qs.exp: 導遊說歡迎來到植物園的熱帶溫室（Tropical House … this glasshouse）＝溫室。植物來自世界各地的雨林，但他們不在雨林裡；商店是導覽結束後才去；建築歷史久，但不是歷史博物館。

qs.q: What does the speaker suggest listeners do with their coats?
opts: Keep them on during the tour
Store them in the gift shop
Hand them to a staff member
qs.exp: 溫室大約二十八度，她建議把外套掛在門邊的衣架上（the rack by the door）＝放在入口附近。因為很熱所以不建議穿著；商店是買種子的地方；沒有說交給工作人員。

qs.q: What will the listeners most likely do next?
opts: Look at some very large aquatic plants
Watch a short film about rainforests
Walk off the path to take photos
qs.exp: 她說第一站就在拱門後面，是巨型睡蓮池，葉子可寬達兩公尺＝接下來去看大型水生植物。買種子是導覽結束後；影片沒提；她要大家走在步道上，不能離開步道。

l34.title: 獨白：旗艦店改裝會議開場（意圖題）

turns.t: Right, let's get started. Thanks for coming, everyone. As you know, our flagship store on Regent Lane will be closed for refurbishment from January to March, and today's meeting is to kick off the planning. The architects have sent their first designs, which I'll share in a moment. The biggest change is moving the café from the basement up to the ground floor, next to the main entrance. That's something our customer surveys have mentioned again and again. Now, the budget has already been approved by the board. What I need from each department is a list of requirements for the new layout. Please send yours to Ellie by the end of next week, and we'll go through them together at our next meeting.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the meeting?
opts: To begin planning a store renovation
To announce that a store will close
To present new customer survey results
qs.exp: 他說今天開會是要啟動改裝規劃（kick off the planning）＝開始規劃店面整修。暫停營業是大家已經知道的事（As you know），不是今天要宣布的；建築師費用和新的問卷結果都沒有要討論。

qs.q: What does the speaker imply when he says, "the budget has already been approved by the board"?
opts: The costs are not open for discussion
The designs must be sent to the board
The project will cost more than planned
He is surprised the board agreed so quickly
qs.exp: 意圖題：他說預算董事會已經核准，接著就說他要的是各部門的需求清單＝經費已定案，今天不討論錢的問題。設計圖不用送董事會；他沒說會超支，也沒表示驚訝。

qs.q: What is suggested about the café?
opts: Customers have asked for it to be relocated
It will close permanently in January
It will be managed by an outside company
It was designed by the same architects
qs.exp: 推論：他說把咖啡廳從地下室搬到一樓入口旁，是顧客問卷一再提到的事＝顧客一直希望咖啡廳換位置。一月是整間店暫停營業，咖啡廳不是永久關閉；外包經營和建築師是誰都沒有提到。

l34.title: 獨白：電台新聞—超市改用電動貨車

turns.t: In local business news, Harvest Lane Grocers announced today that it will replace its entire fleet of home-delivery vans with electric vehicles by the end of next year. The regional chain, which operates twenty-two stores, says the change will cut its fuel costs by nearly half. The first fifteen vans will go into service in Brookfield next month, where the company recently installed charging equipment at its main distribution center. Chief executive Laura Benton said the move was partly a response to customers, many of whom had asked for greener delivery options. The company also plans to hire about thirty more drivers to keep up with the rising number of online orders.

qs.q: What is the news report mainly about?
opts: A company's plan to change its vehicles
The opening of a new grocery store
An increase in local fuel prices
qs.exp: 新聞說 Harvest Lane Grocers 要在明年底前把所有送貨車換成電動車＝公司更換車隊的計畫。它本來就有二十二家店，沒有新開店；油錢是說會省下一半，不是油價上漲；要多聘司機是因為訂單增加，不是缺司機的新聞。

qs.q: What can be inferred about Harvest Lane Grocers' online business?
opts: It is offered in one city only
qs.exp: 推論：公司要多聘約三十名司機，才跟得上越來越多的網路訂單（the rising number of online orders）＝網購業務在成長。不會停止；Brookfield 只是電動車先上路的地方；下個月開始的是新貨車，不是網購服務。

qs.q: According to the report, what has the company done in Brookfield?
qs.exp: 新聞說公司最近在 Brookfield 的主要配送中心裝了充電設備（installed charging equipment）。三十名司機是「打算」聘請，還沒聘，也沒說在 Brookfield；第一家店和總部都沒提。

l34.title: 獨白：渡輪碼頭廣播（圖表題）

turns.t: Attention, please. This is an announcement for passengers on the eleven forty sailing. Unfortunately, this service is delayed by approximately forty-five minutes while our engineers complete a safety check on the vessel. We apologise for the inconvenience. Drivers should remain with their vehicles in lane six and will be called forward for boarding. Foot passengers are invited to wait in the upstairs lounge, where complimentary hot drinks are being served. Simply show your ticket at the café counter. If you have an onward connection after arrival and are worried about missing it, please speak to a member of staff at the ticket office, who can arrange alternative transport.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the announcement?
opts: To report that a departure is late
To announce a change of gate
To introduce a new ferry route
To explain an increase in fares
qs.exp: 廣播說十一點四十分的班次因為安全檢查延誤約四十五分鐘＝報告班次延誤。登船口沒有改；新航線和票價調整都沒有提到。

qs.q: Look at the graphic. Where is the delayed ferry going?
qs.exp: 圖表題：延誤的是 eleven forty（11:40）的班次，表上 11:40 開往 Marrow Island。Port Ellis 是 11:10；Dunmore 是 12:05；Kelby Bay 是 12:30。

qs.q: What are foot passengers encouraged to do?
opts: Get a free drink while they wait
Stay with the vehicles in lane six
Exchange their tickets at the office
qs.exp: 廣播請步行旅客到樓上休息室等候，那裡有免費熱飲（complimentary hot drinks），出示船票即可＝等候時領免費飲料。留在第六車道是開車旅客；沒說改搭下一班；售票處是給擔心轉乘的人安排替代交通，不是換票。

l34.title: 獨白：餐旅論壇介紹講者

turns.t: Good evening, and welcome to the final session of this year's Midwest Hospitality Forum. It's my pleasure to introduce our keynote speaker, Samuel Achebe. Fifteen years ago, Samuel opened a small guesthouse in Duluth with just six rooms. Today, his company, Lakestone Inns, runs thirty-eight boutique hotels across four states. Samuel is known for personally training every new manager he hires, and many of you in this room may have worked for him at some point. Tonight, he'll talk about how independent hotels can compete with large international chains. He'll take questions afterward, so please write yours on the cards on your tables, and our staff will collect them. Please join me in welcoming Samuel Achebe.

qs.q: Who most likely are the listeners?
opts: Guests staying at a boutique hotel
qs.exp: 推論：這是餐旅業論壇（Hospitality Forum），主持人說在座很多人可能曾經在他手下工作過＝飯店業的從業人員。旅遊書作者、住客、商學院學生都和這些線索對不上。

qs.q: What is Samuel Achebe known for?
qs.exp: 主持人說他以親自訓練每一位新經理聞名（personally training every new manager）。室內設計、旅遊寫作都沒提；他經營的是獨立精品旅館，演講主題正是如何和大型國際連鎖競爭。

qs.q: What are listeners asked to do?
opts: Hand their business cards to staff
qs.exp: 主持人請大家把問題寫在桌上的卡片，工作人員會收走＝用書面提問。桌上的卡片是提問卡，不是名片；意見調查和換座位都沒提。

vocab.ex: The HR department introduced flexible hours to reduce absenteeism among factory workers.
vocab.exZh: 人資部推出彈性工時，以降低工廠員工的缺勤率。

vocab.ex: The keynote will be delivered by an accomplished architect with thirty years of experience.
vocab.exZh: 主題演講將由一位擁有三十年經驗、成就卓著的建築師主講。

vocab.ex: Fuel costs have risen sharply, so we have adjusted our delivery fees accordingly.
vocab.exZh: 燃料成本大幅上漲，因此我們已相應調整運費。

vocab.ex: The laboratory received accreditation from the national quality standards agency last month.
vocab.exZh: 該實驗室上個月獲得國家品質標準機構的認證。

vocab.ex: Members accumulate reward points every time they book a room through our website.
vocab.exZh: 會員每次透過我們的網站訂房都能累積紅利點數。

vocab.ex: Please acknowledge receipt of this contract by signing and returning the attached form.
vocab.exZh: 請簽署並寄回附件表格，以確認已收到此合約。

vocab.ex: The warehouse does not have adequate storage space for the holiday inventory.
vocab.exZh: 倉庫沒有足夠的空間存放節慶期間的庫存。

vocab.ex: An outside firm will administer the employee pension plan starting in January.
vocab.exZh: 自一月起，員工退休金計畫將由外部公司負責管理。

vocab.ex: The company formed an advisory committee to guide its expansion into Asian markets.
vocab.exZh: 公司成立了諮詢委員會，為其進軍亞洲市場提供建議。

vocab.ex: Please affix the shipping label to the top of each package before pickup.
